response.overview: A male park worker has the ability to see dwarf-like spirits called Lost Souls, who often wander around the area.While resting on a park bench,he encounters a mysterious woman sitting beside him.At the same time,the park worker is distracted by a jogger running frantically in the background.In the second scene,the mysterious woman is seen walking out of the forest in a daze before sitting next to the park worker.In the third scene, the jogger runs as usual along the jogging path, where he eventually discovers a body hanging from a tree branch at the end of the scene.In reality, the mysterious woman had died; she lost herself in the nearby forest.Her spirit wandered around the park and eventually turned into a Lost Soul. The park worker, seemingly accustomed to such occurrences, walks away from his resting spot. The Lost Soul follows him, and at the same time, several other Lost Souls around the park follow as well.
response.title: Everyday Life (Nichijō)
